mn22:3.4: evaṃ byā kho ahaṃ āvuso bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā yeme antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato nālaṃ antarāyāyāti.
mn22:3.5: atha kho te bhikkhū ariṭṭhaṃ bhikkhuṃ gandhavādhipubbaṃ etasmā pāpakā diṭṭhigatā vivecetukāmā samanuyuñjanti samanuggāhanti samanubhāsanti
mn22:3.6: mā hevaṃ āvuso ariṭṭha avaca mā bhagavantaṃ abbhācikkha na hi sādhu bhagavato abbhakkhānaṃ na hi bhagavā evaṃ vadeyya

mn22:10.1: idha bhikkhave ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti
mn22:10.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhūtadhammaṃ vedallaṃ

mn22:10.12: tamenaṃ bhoge vā naṅguṭṭhe vā gaṇheyya
